Team,

Quick one before our 4pm call: please complete the attached weekly_numbers_template.xlsx with your top 8 commit/opps and update the stage + commit column in HubSpot by 3:30pm PT. We will lock numbers at 5pm, so anything not updated by then will be treated as non-commit for the weekday submission.

Agenda (30m):
- 4:00–4:05pm — Rollcall & quick cadence reminders
- 4:05–4:15pm — High-risk deals (flagging and mitigation owner)
- 4:15–4:25pm — Any late-stage paperwork/PO/procurement blockers (callouts for CS/legal)
- 4:25–4:30pm — Final commit confirmation & next steps (who will submit)

Asks:
- Update HubSpot stage and add a short one-liner in the notes (reason if downgrading)
- Mark deals as "Commit" vs "Best case" in the template — I put a sample row for reference
- Attach any redlines/PO stubs to the HubSpot deal (or drop in the Drive folder linked below)

Attachments: weekly_numbers_template.xlsx (fill and attach back if you have offline changes).
Drive link: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1a2b3c-weekly-numbers
HubSpot: https://app.hubspot.com/contacts/123456/deal/7421

Thanks — will kick things off at 4pm. If you cannot make it, add your updates before 3:30pm and ping the thread so we can note the changes.

— Jonas

Thanks for the quick responses. Final notes before lock:

- Verbal POs: treat as "Pending PO" unless there's a written confirmation (email/PO/contract). Finance will not count a verbal-only confirmation toward committed revenue in the weekly submission.
- DEAL-7421 (Acme) — marked At Risk, owner: Vivek. CS to push SOC2 to procurement before EOD; if not received we will downgrade to Best Case at lock.
- DEAL-7489 — Lauren to confirm pricing concession in HubSpot; flag here once done.
- Everyone: please ensure attachments (SOW/PO/Redlines) are uploaded to the HubSpot deal record or the Drive folder by 4:45pm PT. We will consolidate and submit at exactly 5:00pm PT.

Final agenda for the 4pm huddle is unchanged. If you won't be on the call but have updated the template, add a one-line summary in the HubSpot notes and reply-all with the line so I can read it aloud during Rollcall.

Thanks — see you at 4.

— Jonas
